articles.summary: The freight market is heading into November with rates continuing to climb and capacity tightening across all three equipment types. But higher rates don't automatically mean healthier margins for carriers. Here's what to know as we head toward year-end.
articles.title: Freight Report November 2026

articles.summary: Diesel prices remain elevated heading into November, with regional differences and ongoing crude oil market volatility keeping fuel costs firmly on carriers' radar.
articles.title: Fuel Report November 2026
